decisions.reason: After a 2019 launch with only a brief website mention and no visible follow-through by 2020 or 2021, the option value appears largely resolved on the downside and the firm should stop carrying this construction-site dumper and reallocate resources to stronger core equipment lines.

Although an inclined furniture lift fits the firm's lifting capabilities, its presence only at launch and absence thereafter suggest limited market validation, so the low remaining upside no longer justifies keeping this option open into 2022.

The inclined building material lift had its own launch page in 2019 but no continued website evidence afterward, indicating that enough time has passed to learn that demand is not strong enough to merit further commercial commitment.

A truck-mounted inclined furniture lift could have offered a useful niche extension, but with no sign of sustained promotion or development after 2019, management should treat the experiment as unsuccessful and release the tied-up engineering and service capacity.
